context: Teacher and university student debate the direction of health-policy reform
purpose: Teach: 療法/強力/圧倒的/振興/大衆/勢力/動向/報酬

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、最近の健康政策の動向を見ていると、予防医療ばかりが強調されていて、新しい療法の研究予算が削られているように感じます。
lines.en: Professor, looking at recent health policy trends, prevention keeps getting emphasized, but I feel research budgets for new treatments are being cut.
lines.style: earnest graduate student opening a debate with measured concern

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 鋭い指摘ですね。確かに業界の動向を見ると、製薬会社の影響力は依然として圧倒的ですが、政府の振興策はむしろ生活習慣改善に傾いています。
lines.en: A sharp observation. Looking at industry trends, pharma's influence remains overwhelming, yet the government's promotion policies lean toward lifestyle reform.
lines.style: thoughtful teacher acknowledging the point while reframing it carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも産業振興と国民の健康って、本当に両立できるんでしょうか。結局、強力なロビー団体の勢力に押されて妥協が生まれるだけでは。
lines.en: But can industrial promotion and public health really coexist? In the end, won't powerful lobbying forces just push us toward compromise?
lines.style: skeptical undergraduate pressing harder with youthful frustration

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その懸念はもっともです。ただ、大衆向けの啓発キャンペーンが思った以上に効果を上げている地域もあるんですよ。
lines.en: That concern is valid. However, there are regions where mass-public awareness campaigns have produced more impact than expected.
lines.style: patient instructor offering a counterexample with quiet conviction

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは一部の成功例ですよね。医師への報酬体系自体を変えない限り、構造的な問題は解決しないと思うんです。
lines.en: Those are just isolated successes, aren't they? Unless we change the physician compensation system itself, the structural issues won't be resolved.
lines.style: ambitious student doubling down with policy-wonk confidence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 報酬制度の改革は確かに核心ですね。インセンティブが治療件数に偏れば、予防は永遠に後回しになります。
lines.en: Compensation reform is indeed the heart of the matter. If incentives skew toward treatment volume, prevention will be perpetually deprioritized.
lines.style: seasoned academic conceding ground with intellectual generosity

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ですよね。結局、どの勢力に政策決定の権限が集中するかで、改革の方向が決まってしまう気がして。
lines.en: Right? In the end, whichever faction holds policy-making authority seems to decide the direction of reform.
lines.style: student sighing with realistic resignation but still engaged

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: だからこそ、あなたたち若い世代が冷静に動向を分析して声を上げることが、何よりの抑止力になるんですよ。
lines.en: That's precisely why your younger generation analyzing trends calmly and speaking up becomes the strongest deterrent of all.
lines.style: encouraging mentor turning the discussion toward responsibility
